moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins this Friday, promising a weekend packed with top-flight football action across the UK.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Buzz
angles.copy: The wait is over! Premier League football returns this Friday. Who are you backing for the opening weekend? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Team Specific Angle
angles.copy: Your team is back in action this weekend as the Premier League season kicks off! Get ready for the roar of the crowd. #FootballIsBack

moments.title: Creamfields Festival
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic music festivals, returns for four days of non-stop dance music from August 27-30 in Daresbury, Cheshire.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Creamfields is just days away! Who's heading to Daresbury for the UK's biggest dance festival? Get ready for huge beats. #Creamfields

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Four days of incredible dance music await! Creamfields 2026 kicks off next week, bringing the biggest names in electronic music to Cheshire. #DanceMusic

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The UK's August Bank Holiday weekend is fast approaching, offering a long weekend for many across the country on Monday, August 25, 2026.

angles.name: Long Weekend Plans
angles.copy: That August Bank Holiday feeling is just around the corner! What are your plans for the long weekend? #BankHoliday

angles.name: Make it Count
angles.copy: Only a few days until the August Bank Holiday! Make the most of that extra day off. What's on your agenda?
